## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 4 (*Jatumaṭṭhaka*, "Using a dildo") is an offense of expiation (*pācittiya*) in the Theravāda Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule establishes that a Buddhist nun who uses a dildo (*jatumaṭṭhaka*) commits a confession-entailing infraction [Hirakawa 1982]. The text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

 Akira Hirakawa additionally notes the rule's correspondence to the Mahāsāṃghika Bhikṣuṇī Vinaya's regulation against making and using dildos [Hirakawa 1982].

Within the Pali canon, the DharmaNexus database detects 147 internal text-reuse passages shared across 57 texts, driven predominantly by standardized procedural and legal formulas shared with other Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga chapters [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial formulaic overlaps occur with Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Saṅghādisesa 3 (over 1,700 shared characters, prominently at §1.13–1.20) and several other Pācittiya rules, including Pc 2, Pc 6, Pc 55, and Pc 89 [DharmaNexus].
